title: Provenance Graph Record
$comment: One JSONL line of reports/provenance_graph.jsonl (DESIGN-retraction-closure §4). The file is generated by the writers themselves and never hand-edited; this schema validates a SINGLE record, because a line-delimited file has no document root to attach a schema to. Committed BEFORE the assembler exists (v0.16 preregistration), so the node kinds, the relation vocabulary, and the inferred/emitted distinction cannot be widened later to make a construction-gate clause pass. Claims are nodes only when they carry a machine-locatable anchor; unanchored prose is reported as unprovenanced on the certificate, never silently absent from the graph's accounting.

kind.$comment: The seven kinds of §4, frozen as an enum. The chain the design says never adopted the repo's own conventions is exactly seed_script → corpus_file → report_ledger → ledger_section → analysis_claim → release_claim; external_source is the pinned outside input (the proof_correspondence.json precedent).

content_sha256.$comment: Identity of the node's bytes at first_seen_build. For a ledger_section or a claim this is the hash of the anchored text, which is what makes a claim locatable by machine rather than by reading.

produced_by.$comment: The writer that emitted this node. The empty string is permitted and means only one thing: an external_source, which the repo pins but does not produce. It is never a placeholder for an unknown producer — a node whose producer is unknown does not enter the graph.

inferred.$comment: an edge reconstructed after the fact; excluded from every scored clause (design §4)
